name: Reverse the Polarity
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Counter all other spells.
• Switch each creature's power and toughness until end of turn.
• Creatures can't be blocked this turn.
blocked_sentences: • Switch each creature's power and toughness until end of turn.

needs.what: an op that switches the power and toughness of every creature matched by a selector (here each creature on the battlefield, any controller) until end of turn, as a layer-7d effect (613.4d) applied after every other P/T effect so pumps and counters are included in the swap
needs.why_existing_wont_do: set_pt takes only objects/power/toughness: it sets constants (or snapshots power_of/toughness_of in layer 7b, ignoring later pumps and counters) and has no duration for 'until end of turn'; pump adds constants. No op or static in reference performs the layer-7d switch

needs.what: the counter op applied to every spell on the stack other than this one, chosen by a stack selector rather than a target ('Counter all other spells', untargeted, so hexproof-like and target-legality rules do not apply)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: op_counter (ops_stack.py) resolves its victims only from `sid` or from the `target` id's chosen sids; although `objects` appears in its op_options, the op body never reads it, so there is no way to name 'all spells except this one' without inventing targets the card does not have
